about: Data sources for the defect classifier (task M7, data part of M6). Every source passes L2 (PLAN.md §5): CC BY 4.0, CC BY 2.0/3.0, CC0 or public domain; nothing non-commercial, share-alike or research-only, nothing from closed apps, nothing synthetic. Raw files live under data/datasets/ (gitignored); training/datasets/defects.py builds the crops. `crops` counts are written by `defects.py manifest`.

sources.name: VisA (Visual Anomaly), PCB categories pcb1-pcb4
sources.licence_evidence: LICENSE-DATASET inside the archive and the repository README
sources.attribution: Zou, Jeong, Pemula, Zhang, Dabeer. SPot-the-Difference Self-Supervised Pre-training for Anomaly Detection and Segmentation. ECCV 2022, arXiv:2207.14315
sources.content: Photos of four PCB designs (about 1400 x 1070 px), normal and anomalous, with pixel masks. pcb1-3: bent, melt, missing, scratch. pcb4: missing, extra, dirt, wrong place, damage, burnt, scratch.
sources.use: pcb1-3 train/val/test, split by board photo (each photo is its own board unit). pcb4 HELD OUT: another board design and defect kinds never trained on; never used for training or thresholds.
sources.subset: all anomalous photos; 150 normal photos per board for pcb1-3 and 200 for pcb4, seeded

sources.name: keremberke/pcb-defect-segmentation (Hugging Face mirror of Roboflow Universe 'defects-2q87r', diplom-qz7q6)
sources.licence_evidence: dataset card and README.roboflow.txt; uploader-provided (one Roboflow user)
sources.content: 189 webcam close-ups (640 x 480) of assembled boards with defect boxes: dry_joint, short_circuit, incorrect_installation, pcb_damage.
sources.use: train/val/test split by capture day (train 2022-10-17, 10-30, 11-02; val 10-23; test 11-03)

sources.name: Roboflow 100 'printed-circuit-board' (Hugging Face mirror)
sources.licence_evidence: README.dataset.txt in the archive: 'License: CC BY 4.0'
sources.content: Photos of many real boards (640 x 640) with component boxes, no defect annotation.
sources.use: ok crops only, split by board name. Assumption: the photographed boards are not defective (not verified per board).

sources.name: Wikimedia Commons, Category:Defective capacitors (capacitor plague)
sources.licence: per file: CC0, public domain, CC BY 2.0/3.0/4.0 only (share-alike files excluded)
sources.licence_evidence: Commons extmetadata LicenseShortName per file, recorded with author and sha1 in data/datasets/wikimedia/files.json and eval/defects/wikimedia_files.json
sources.content: Real photos of blown, bulging, leaking or burnt capacitors, mostly on boards.
sources.use: HELD OUT evaluation only (the motivating case; no training data of this kind exists in the sources above).

excluded.name: Roboflow 100 cable-damage
excluded.reason: steel wire rope, not product wiring; many frames are Bandicam screen recordings of someone else's video (provenance)

excluded.name: Roboflow 100 corrosion-bi3q3
excluded.reason: drone shots of bridges with boxes of a few pixels: not the domain

excluded.name: MVTec AD / 3D-AD, Real-IAD, MANTA, KolektorSDD, MPDD, Innodisk PCB
DefectSpectrum
excluded.reason: MIT annotations on top of MVTec (non-commercial) images
